body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized camera, 57 x 39 x 33 mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring right of centre (a quarter of the width), flash window upper left, shutter and recessed switch on top left over the grip, USB-C and microSD on the right side. Idea LINE FIELD, lensing drawn as in image[2]: a crisp matte black block whose front, top and grip end carry one continuous field of fine raised ridges with light-grey crests. Over the grip they stand straight and vertical at 2.4 mm pitch as grip ribs; toward the lens they bow round it and crowd to 0.6 mm pitch until they fuse into a solid black band hugging the ring: light cannot escape. On top they part round the shutter collar like round a smaller mass; flash window and two light-pipe dots sit where lines open. image[3] = such ridges as a real moulded surface. image[4] = ribbed ring with red index triangle, for the lens ring; one red ridge is the index line. Vent slots cut in the bottom valleys, plug cover with exhaust slots on the left end, corner eyelet, shadow-gap seam at the back. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
